scenes.title: Heimkehr in Zimmer acht
scenes.summary: After settling the retired mapmaker happily at table one under the shade tree, Hannah, Arthur, and Caleb step to the front desk to fetch the green guest book and brass key number 8.

scenes.title: Sommerkuchen in Scheiben
scenes.summary: At the bustling café counter, Tessa plates generous slices of berry-and-almond cake while Owen and Hannah report that the honored guest called it identical to thirty summers ago.

scenes.title: Das vierhändige Duett
scenes.summary: Inside Room 9, Evelyn and Caleb perform their joyful four-hand piano duet through the open shutters to warm applause from all twenty-eight courtyard seats.

scenes.title: Die gemalte Landkarte
scenes.summary: Under the shade tree, Hannah reads the retired mapmaker's warm written toast aloud while Arthur and Tessa unveil his gift: a framed watercolor map of Linden Street with Linden Courtyard Inn glowing at its center.

scenes.title: Eine neue Dose für morgen
scenes.summary: As early evening settles in, Graham surprises Hannah inside Room 9 with a brand-new brass-rimmed tin box and waxed linen to seal a new time capsule for thirty summers ahead.

scenes.title: Vier kleine Andenken
scenes.summary: Around the Room 9 table, Tessa, Evelyn, and Owen place the complete laminated berry-cake recipe, the signed waltz sheet, wooden clothespin number 9, and a fresh group sketch into the new tin.

scenes.title: Zurück unter den dritten Stein
scenes.summary: Under twenty-four glowing lanterns at twilight, Graham, Arthur, and Hannah lower the new waxed-cloth capsule into the brick pocket beneath the third flagstone north of the shade tree.

scenes.title: Der Umschlag zum Herbstfest
scenes.summary: Hanging the framed watercolor map beside the front desk at nine in the evening, Hannah and Arthur discover an official municipal envelope from Owen inviting Linden Courtyard Inn into the autumn Historic Courtyard Festival.
